comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks damping through test impacts; pr-890 seats a bracket bolt using a ratchet in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require tool alignment and bounded rotation. Candidate inserts a hex key into a setscrew, unlocks, fine-tunes a separate collar, relocks, and iterates from observed motion. pr-890 picks up and seats a socket ratchet, then executes repeated short drive/return strokes through a one-way clutch.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two impacts within energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift constraints. pr-890 requires at least 1.8 bolt turns, measured head-to-bracket seating contact, six advance/return cycles, socket engagement, and no integrity or torque fault.
comparison.reason: Confined ratcheting tests incremental fastener advance and seating; the candidate tests calibration of energy absorption plus independent setting retention. Generic tool insertion and tightening do not establish overlap.
